svg.title: The frames of factorial(3)
svg.desc: Five frames stacked, newest on top. Tags 1 to 4: the frames of factorial(0), running and drawn with a thick border, then factorial(1), factorial(2) and factorial(3), each with its own name n referring to the int 0, 1, 2 and 3. Tag 5: the module's frame, at the bottom. A curved arrow goes from each frame to the frame below it.
